news.summary: Nektar reported a Q2 EPS loss of $1.23 (beating consensus of -$1.97) on revenue of $21.6 million, with cash and investments surging to $1.023 billion (from $245.8 million at year-end 2025), giving a cash runway into Q3 2028 that extends past the first Phase 3 ZENITH AD data readout. Management reiterated the path to a first BLA submission for rezpegaldesleukin in 2029.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Coverage Initiated at Canaccord Genuity Group
news.summary: Canaccord Genuity analyst Edward Nash initiated coverage of Nektar with a Buy rating and a $153 price target, citing the newly launched Phase 3 program for rezpegaldesleukin in atopic dermatitis as the key value driver.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Start of Phase 3 ZENITH AD Program Evaluating Novel Regulatory T-Cell Biologic Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: Nektar dosed the first patients in ZENITH AD-1 and ZENITH AD-2, two global registrational Phase 3 trials (with a third, ZENITH AD-3, to follow) evaluating rezpegaldesleukin in patients aged 12+ with moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis. The trial design reflects FDA and EMA scientific-advice feedback, with initial topline data expected mid-2028.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Stock Climbs As Immunology Sentiment Improves
news.summary: NKTR shares jumped roughly 10.65% intraday as sector-wide immunology sentiment improved following AbbVie's prospective acquisition of Apogee Therapeutics, with Canaccord specifically naming Nektar as an inflammation/immunology name positioned to benefit from the read-through.

catalysts.label: FDA End-of-Phase 2 alignment follow-through for alopecia areata
catalysts.detail: Nektar completed its End-of-Phase 2 meeting with FDA on the REZOLVE-AA data; final Phase 3 protocol details for alopecia areata are expected to be finalized this quarter ahead of trial start.

catalysts.label: Phase 3 alopecia areata trial initiation
catalysts.detail: Nektar plans to start a single registrational Phase 3 study of rezpegaldesleukin in severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata, building on positive Phase 2b (REZOLVE-AA) 52-week data.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD Phase 3 topline data (atopic dermatitis)
catalysts.detail: First topline readouts expected from the ZENITH AD-1/AD-2 registrational trials in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis, the first Phase 3 data for rezpegaldesleukin.

catalysts.label: Planned first BLA submission for rezpegaldesleukin
catalysts.detail: Management has guided to a first Biologics License Application submission (atopic dermatitis) in 2029, contingent on positive ZENITH AD Phase 3 results.

catalysts.label: Type 1 diabetes Phase 2 trial
catalysts.detail: Rezpegaldesleukin is also being evaluated in a Phase 2 study in Type 1 diabetes mellitus, an earlier-stage optionality catalyst outside the core dermatology/immunology franchise.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Next scheduled quarterly financial results and pipeline update call, expected roughly three months after the August 13, 2026 Q2 report.

pulse: Nektar has pivoted decisively into late-stage execution mode: it dosed the first patients in its Phase 3 ZENITH AD program for rezpegaldesleukin in atopic dermatitis in July 2026 and is on track to start a registrational Phase 3 alopecia areata study in early 2027, backed by over $1 billion in cash (runway into Q3 2028, past the first Phase 3 readout expected mid-2028). Sell-side sentiment has turned sharply bullish, with Canaccord initiating at Buy ($153 PT) and multiple firms lifting targets well above $150 on the strength of the Treg-biologic thesis, while a Russell index inclusion has broadened passive ownership. The stock remains a binary, multi-year story pinned to rezpegaldesleukin's Phase 3 data in 2028 and a targeted 2029 BLA, with no near-term revenue catalysts beyond partnership or financing headlines.
